items.title: Home cleaning
items.text: A clean and pleasant everyday life.

sections.title: Born from Experience, Guided by Heart
paragraphs: Orion Home was founded by someone who understands cleaning from the ground up. After years of working as a cleaner and noticing that many methods lacked both soul and precision, we created our own way — one that values quality, respect, and human connection.

We don't just clean — we care, we observe, and we transform. Our unique method blends Brazilian warmth and attention to detail with Scandinavian efficiency, treating every home as a sacred space that deserves respect and presence.

sections.title: Changing Lives Through Cleaning
paragraphs: Our mission goes beyond spotless surfaces. We believe that a clean home creates emotional balance, peace, and clarity. For us, cleaning isn't a chore — it's an act of care, and even healing, that leaves beauty, order, and light behind.

Every team member is personally trained in our method, creating not just technical excellence but awareness and intuition. Many of our clients say they feel renewed peace, energy, and joy after our visits — because our cleaning is visible, but its effects are also emotional and energetic.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our professional cleaning services in Stockholm.

items.question: What cleaning services do you offer in Stockholm?
items.answer: We offer a full range of professional cleaning services in Stockholm and the surrounding area: regular home cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, and office cleaning. All services can be scheduled as a one-time visit or on a recurring basis — weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly.

items.question: Are your cleaning products eco-friendly?
items.answer: Yes. We use only eco-friendly, non-toxic products that are safe for children, pets, and people with allergies. Our commitment to sustainable cleaning means a healthier home for your family and a smaller environmental footprint.

items.question: How do I book a cleaning service?
items.answer: Booking is easy. Send a request through our contact form or message us on WhatsApp. We will get back to you with a quote, confirm your appointment and answer any questions about your specific cleaning needs.

items.question: Are your cleaners insured and background-checked?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every Orion Home cleaner is fully insured and has passed a thorough background check. We are a responsible cleaning company and take your trust and safety seriously on every visit.

items.question: What is the difference between regular cleaning and deep cleaning?
items.answer: Regular cleaning covers routine maintenance — dusting, vacuuming, mopping, and cleaning bathrooms and kitchens. Deep cleaning goes further, targeting hard-to-reach areas, the inside of appliances, behind furniture, and built-up grime that regular cleaning does not address. We recommend a deep clean before starting a regular schedule or after long periods without cleaning.

items.question: Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?
items.answer: Yes. We stand behind our work with a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If you are not happy with any part of the cleaning, contact us within 24 hours and we will return to re-clean at no extra charge.
